charts.title: Main: paired success differences with saved 95% CI
charts.note: Canonical final aggregation; 40 sample clusters / 80 paired runs per point. Intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity; endpoint zero does not establish superiority or equivalence.

charts.title: Main: failure tags across all 12 cells
charts.note: Tags overlap: never sum to infer failed runs. Blank cells are zero. P=Proposed, SW=Sliding, V=Vector, U=Utility. 1K preflight stops are retained. Color scale: 0 to 80 tagged runs.

charts.title: Main: task-family outcomes at the 2K boundary
charts.note: Published phase tables; 10 shared base tasks x 2 repeats per family/strategy. These are subsets of final Main, not extra independent runs. No family-level intervals were supplied.

charts.title: Main: observed success and generation-cost trade-off
charts.note: Marker area encodes 2K/4K/8K budget (small/medium/large); concentric points overlap. 1K is omitted here because Proposed did not execute. H100/2K cost means use 78 Sliding and 79 Utility runs. Stored usage is an estimate, not a total bill; intervals shown in other Main figures.

charts.title: Main: cumulative provider usage versus peak counted input
charts.note: Cumulative usage: rounded published phase means, no intervals reported. Peak context: saved canonical summary means. 80 live runs per point. A multi-call run can have cumulative input above its single-request budget. These are subsets of final Main.

charts.title: Early pilots: recorded outcomes with known measurement limitations
charts.note: Report aggregates; P=Proposed, SW=Sliding, V=Vector, U=Utility. First two runs have contradictory success/selection-failure metrics; first Gemini run fails budgeting before valid execution. Gemini v2 lacks current provenance/cost accounting. Do not compare with final Main.

charts.title: Token-budget preflight: safety margin 0 versus 32
charts.note: Published report table; 8 fixed scenarios, one run per strategy/condition; 128 runs total. 1K Proposed stops before model execution. No intervals reported; identical observed rates do not establish equivalence.

charts.title: Output-limit validation: 512 versus 2048 tokens
charts.note: Published report table: same 10 selected inputs per strategy; one execution, not the 12-cell Main design. Proposed has two 1K budget stops in the new run. Parse errors and MAX_TOKENS are distinct diagnostics; no paired CI supplied.

charts.title: Output-limit 2048 validation: selected-input budget breakdown
charts.note: Published aggregate counts. Each budget includes only 2 or 4 selected inputs per strategy; mixed tasks/horizons are not fully crossed. 38 live runs, 75 STOP responses; no observed parse or input-budget errors. Exploratory instrumentation check, not final Main.

charts.title: Ablation: quality and memory preservation
charts.note: Freeze 1.0.3: no_temporal also disables mandatory state. Checked-in 2K aggregates; the report states all 400 paired 4K outcomes match. Error bars: reported sample-cluster bootstrap 95% CI.

charts.title: Ablation: retrieval and failure diagnostics
charts.note: Freeze 1.0.3, 2K/H100. Recall, precision, and MRR are scaled to 0-100. Failure labels can overlap; constraint violation uses n=40, other shown diagnostics n=80. Heatmap shows means.

charts.title: Ablation: tokens, estimated cost, and recorded latency
charts.note: Input is peak counted context, not cumulative provider usage. Token and cost means match between 2K and 4K. Latency includes OS/commit differences and is not a causal budget comparison. Costs are recorded LLM estimates, excluding CountTokens and infrastructure.

charts.title: Temporal ablation: corrected condition and paired effects
charts.note: v1.0.3 no_temporal disables temporal AND mandatory state; v1.0.4 disables temporal only. Full rerun reuses the same tasks. Corrected temporal comparison uses historical v1.0.3 Full; CIs include zero.

charts.title: Budget pressure: memory retention and task success
charts.note: Report-derived values. Rho interpolates between mandatory and all-candidate boundaries; it is not a total-budget fraction. At rho=0, no-packing retention excludes 2 absent contexts (n=78); success includes all 80 runs. No CIs reported for these means.

charts.title: Budget pressure: first, intermediate, and final contexts
charts.note: Report-derived Full condition. Exclusions count events across steps, not unique memories. Final retention does not describe the first action: at rho=0, first-step retention remains 89.2%.

charts.title: Budget pressure: the additional failure at rho=0
charts.note: Report-derived failure case: same first-step memory set, different ordering and generated feedback. Nominal budget 1,484 minus safety margin 32. This is a specific trace, not a general packing success guarantee.

charts.title: Long horizon and state updates: six unique cells
charts.note: Report-derived values; 6 unique cells / 1,920 runs total, each point 40 tasks x 2 repeats. Vector/Utility success rates overlap. Snapshot selection with Top-k=5; this is not 1,000 online agent turns. No marginal CIs supplied for every point.

charts.title: State updates: initial retrieval and context recovery
charts.note: Report-derived rates are identical at H100 and H1000 (80 runs per strategy/update/horizon). This diagnostic tracks one correct State, not all required constraints. Correct State is substantially longer than other versions in these synthetic inputs.

charts.title: State updates at H1000: stale states and approval violations
charts.note: Report-derived H1000 values. Vector and Utility overlap; their displayed rates also recur at H100. Stale usage excludes 20 historical-state requests; zero stale usage alone does not imply task success.

charts.title: Sliding Window: which task types fail as versions increase
charts.note: Report-derived H100 subgroup counts. Stale-state usage is zero for Sliding, but historical versions and approval behavior still produce failures. Each condition reuses the same ten base tasks per subgroup with two repeats.

charts.title: Long horizon inputs: measured history and State-memory lengths
charts.note: Report-derived min-max ranges, not confidence intervals. History is restored as a synthetic snapshot; the full 128K history is not sent to the LLM. Correct-State padding and fixed Top-k=5 limit generalization.

charts.title: Critical Flexible preflight: selection across budget levels
charts.note: Selection only; 160 scenarios from 40 base tasks; 1,600 context evaluations. Budget is normalized separately from each scenario's mandatory floor to its ceiling; no LLM generation. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Critical Flexible pilot: first-step diagnostics
charts.note: Single-step LLM pilot; 32 scenarios per preset, 64 runs; 75% normalized budget. Email-only metrics have n=16. All runs ended at max_steps=1; these are not final task completion rates. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Critical Flexible pilot: input size and reported cost
charts.note: Historical reported estimates for this one-step pilot; 32 runs per preset. Reported cost is approximate and is not a current pricing estimate or evidence of general cost superiority. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Critical Flexible holdout: first-action correctness
charts.note: 160 paired scenarios from 40 base tasks; separate seeds and templates; one LLM run per preset/scenario. A=short/short, B=short/long, C=long/short, D=long/long (critical/distractor). Correctness verifies the call, required arguments and tool effect; max_steps=1, not final task completion. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Critical Flexible holdout: paired first-action outcomes
charts.note: Totals: both correct 114, both incorrect 4, Full only 3, No packing only 39. The same 40 base tasks occur in A-D; first-action outcomes do not measure final completion. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Packing alpha: long critical memory with short distractors
charts.note: Condition C, 75% normalized budget; same development data, not an independent holdout. Score=utility / tokens**alpha. LLM: 40 scenarios per tested alpha, 120 one-step runs; alpha=0.5 was selection-only. Critical context inclusion equals first-action correctness in all reported LLM arms. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Task Criticality: critical-memory inclusion at 75% budget
charts.note: 480 selection-only contexts; same 160 development scenarios as the earlier Flexible preflight, not a new holdout. A=short/short, B=short/long, C=long/short, D=long/long. All policies retrieved 160/160 critical memories; no LLM generation or tool execution. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: S2/S3/S5 stress preflight: selection and slot-detection signals
charts.note: Each measure has 40 scenarios. v0.1 and v0.2 reuse the same development dataset; 480 contexts per run. S2 reverses importance; S3 tests valid/missing evidence; S5 tests conflict. Selection and detection signals are different measures; neither execution blocking nor LLM correctness is measured. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: S2/S3/S5 stress preflight: context exposure before and after v0.2
charts.note: Bars count memory items summed across 40 scenarios per variant, not scenario success rates. v0.2 removes invalid S3 evidence, while S5's two conflicting memories remain exposed in every scenario. Selection-only development data; no LLM generation or tool execution. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Safety Gate v0.3: fixed scripted actions with gate OFF / ON
charts.note: 160 scenarios and 320 pipeline runs per freeze version. Gate ON allowed all 80 valid actions and blocked all 80 invalid actions. ScriptedPlanner, max_steps=1, LLM generation=0; these counts do not estimate LLM safety or task success. Freeze 1.0.5 changed the blocking reason in 40 approval-email rows, while aggregate outcomes stayed identical. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Safety Gate ON: allowed and blocked scripted actions by variant
charts.note: Identical aggregate results in Freeze 1.0.4 and 1.0.5; 40 scenarios per variant. Fixed valid S2/S3_VALID actions were allowed; deliberately ungrounded S3_EMPTY/S5 actions were blocked before ToolExecutor. No LLM generation or multi-step agent evaluation. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Narrative modes: offline retrieval sensitivity
charts.note: Published report table; 40 paired tasks per mode; Proposed general pool is retrieval only, before selection. No Agent/LLM generation or confidence intervals.

charts.title: Narrative modes: paired retrieval changes
charts.note: Published report table; each contrast reuses the same 40 tasks. Differences are descriptive; mode comparisons are not additional independent samples.

charts.title: Target/noise padding: 2 x 2 offline retrieval audit
charts.note: Published report tables; 40 paired tasks; paired bootstrap 4,000 resamples. Target effects match at both noise settings; noise effects match at both target settings. No Agent execution.

charts.title: Final-context audit: initial misses recovered
charts.note: Published report tables; 40 paired tasks per mode, no LLM generation. Token whiskers show observed min-max, not confidence intervals. Final context overflow: 0/80 rows.

charts.title: Narrative modes: actual Agent/Tool behavior
charts.note: Published report table; same 40 paired tasks, one execution per strategy/mode. Task bootstrap: 2,000 resamples. Constraint violations: 0/20 in all four conditions; not pooled with Main.

charts.title: Narrative modes: measured Agent resources
charts.note: Published report means; 40 executions per condition. Cost is provider-usage-based estimated cost, scaled to 1,000 runs for readability; not a billing total. No resource confidence intervals reported.

charts.title: Attachment recheck: one task repeated five times per mode
charts.note: Published report tables; ONE fixed approval task, five repeats per mode. Repeats are not five independent tasks or a general mode-effect estimate. No actual email was sent.

charts.title: Action-time preflight: flexible-memory selection by budget
charts.note: Published report table; 40 paired tasks at each normalized level; 400 context evaluations, all valid. No critical-memory labels or LLM actions; recovery is not correctness or task success.

charts.title: Constraint coverage: legacy inputs and balanced generator
charts.note: Coverage JSON plus published reports; 40 task identities per dataset. Legacy prohibited files do not restrict actual visible candidates. Declared applicability and behavioral necessity differ; no new LLM performance results.

charts.title: Constraint retention and separate synthetic evaluator controls
charts.note: Left: existing LLM Ablation runs, 40 tasks x 2 repeats; preservation disabled does not delete constraints. Right: artificial evaluator traces only, no LLM. The two panels have different scopes and denominators.

charts.title: Balanced generator: answer positions and offline validation
charts.note: Offline provisional tokenizer, constant test embedding, integration top-k 20. 480 appearances reuse 40 task identities across 12 cells. These checks do not measure LLM or experimental top-k 5 performance.

charts.title: 4K/8K readiness gate: prompt instrumentation
charts.note: Published report table; eight fixed tasks x four strategies per budget. Operational readiness only; no comparative performance inference. Safety margin: 32 tokens.

charts.title: Pipeline smoke: five fixed inputs and execution checks
charts.note: Published report tables; latest of three snapshots using the same five tasks. A pipeline diagnostic, not a strategy performance estimate; repeated snapshots are not independent tasks.

charts.title: Repeated smoke snapshots: observation archive
charts.note: Published report tables; same five tasks in every snapshot, with different code commits. Nov 8 snapshots are dirty. Counts are separate records; no pooled success rate or temporal/causal trend is estimated.

charts.title: Early runner fixtures: development diagnostics only
charts.note: Published archive table; provisional counter and incomplete provenance. quant_pilot_sanity contains contradictory success/selection diagnostics. These observations must not support strategy comparisons or be pooled with later experiments.

limitations: Missing run logs were not reconstructed. Report tables are explicitly identified.
Existing confidence intervals are preserved; no new intervals are inferred from aggregates.
Main phases are subsets of the final Main experiment, not independent extra runs.
Offline selection, scripted safety gates, smoke tests, and LLM outcomes are separate experiments.
No model calls, evaluator changes, or edits to original experiment data were made.
